## Migrations

- `storage.ensure_schema_ready` — verifies `books.*` schema exists; raises if missing. Migration-time only, not an app-start or test side effect (commit "fix: init_schema() is migration-time-only, not an app-start/test side effect").
- `python3 -m bookmatch.storage` — one-time bootstrap/upgrade of the `books.*` schema, run explicitly by a role holding CREATE on the database.
- The repo owns no database objects beyond the `books.*` schema bootstrapped by `python3 -m bookmatch.storage`; no ordered migration list exists in the fact sheet.

## DDL surface

- `books.v_bookmatch_correctness` — defined in `sql/v_bookmatch_correctness.sql` (line 1). Per-account correctness surface: asserts shelf ingested, taste axes complete, UCSD corpus matched, non-empty recs + profile.

## Triggers & guarantees

- `books.v_bookmatch_correctness` — a view, not a trigger; asserts grounded pipeline output per account. Health is not modelled there — that stays the live systemd + `/api/health` probe.
- `book_lookup.sqlite` — `PRAGMA journal_mode=OFF` and `synchronous=OFF` for speed during index build (scripts/build_index.py:88).
- `book_lookup.sqlite` — index on the `lookup` table's `normkey` column (scripts/build_index.py:120).
- No append-only triggers or uniqueness guards in the fact sheet; the only constraint is the `normkey` index on `book_lookup.sqlite`.

## Decision semantics

### Index-build filtering

- Input: `goodreads_interactions.csv` rows with `user_id`, `book_id`, `is_read`, `rating`, `is_reviewed` columns (scripts/build_index.py:5).
- Verdict: only rated interactions (`rating` in 1..5) are kept as the collaborative filtering signal (scripts/build_index.py:15).
- Output: `user_item.npz` as a scipy CSR matrix of explicit ratings (scripts/build_index.py:11).

### ID canonicalisation

- Input: `book_id_map.csv` with remapped `book_id` to real `book_id` mapping (scripts/build_index.py:77).
- Input: `goodreads_books.json.gz` containing real `book_id` to title and authors mapping (scripts/build_index.py:7).
- Input: `goodreads_book_authors.json.gz` mapping `author_id` to name (scripts/build_index.py:8).
- Output: `book_lookup.sqlite` with `books` and `lookup` tables indexed by `normkey` (scripts/build_index.py:12).

## Deploy mechanics

- `deploy.sh` — in-place deploy: the systemd unit (`bookmatch.service.template`) runs this checkout directly on aurora. Deploy = restart the unit with the merged code, then prove health.
- `deploy.sh` refuses to deploy with a dirty working tree (deploy.sh:11).
- Fail-loud everywhere: no sudo ticket, failed restart, or a dead `/api/health` all abort non-zero.
- `install_hooks.sh` — activates tracked git hooks by setting `core.hooksPath` to `.githooks` (scripts/install_hooks.sh:7). Must be run once per fresh clone to activate the ADR-0020 test gate (scripts/install_hooks.sh:4).
